address: Hong Lim Market and Food Centre, #02-48/49, Blk 531A, Upper Cross Street, 051531, Singapore
bio: Order the Ji Ji noodle bowl – noodle soup or ‘dry’ noodles are topped with char siew, deep-fried wonton and veggies and served with wonton soup. Pork crackling adds a lovely crunch. A dab of homemade chilli sauce is a must....
